description.value: Provisions Kitsilano is an all-day neighbourhood cafe that opened in May 2025 on West 4th Avenue, a well-travelled cycling corridor linking Kitsilano Beach to the broader Vancouver waterfront network. Part of a two-location group with a flagship in Whistler Village, it features a custom-roasted espresso bar, freshly baked pastries from an in-house baker, and a full menu running from breakfast through dinner. The cafe offers both dine-in and takeout with online ordering, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists before or after rides along the Seaside Greenway.
